JOB TITLE:
IT Officer / IT Engineer

COMPANY:
WHA Industrial Development PLC

LOCATION:
WHA Eastern Seaboard Industrial Estate 4, Rayong

SALARY:
25,000 - 35,000 THB

JOB DETAILS & QUALIFICATIONS:
Responsibilities:
1. Maintain company IT infrastructure, servers, Active Directory, and local network operations.
2. Provide technical tier 1 & 2 user support for internal staff across office and industrial site.
3. Manage IT asset lifecycle, hardware troubleshooting, software licensing, and inventory.
4. Coordinate with external vendors for network equipment procurement and maintenance.

Qualifications:
- Male / Female, age 24 - 30 years old.
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, IT or related fields.
- 1 to 3 years of experience in IT Support, System Administrator, or Network Engineer role.
- Good knowledge of TCP/IP, Router, Switch, Firewall, Active Directory, and Windows Server.
- Able to work on-site at WHA Eastern Seaboard Industrial Estate 4, Rayong.
